record.question: When an absconded offender appears in Court or is arrested by parties other than the Excise and Narcotics of the Station which a warrant was sent in the first instance, or when a warrant is cancelled under section 70 , Criminal Procedure Code, 1978:
options: The Court will file a fresh warrant.
The Court Officer will issue a new warrant
The Court Officer will send intimation to the Excise and Narcotics Station and ask for the return of the warrant
The Court will take no further action
